Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely marked the task complete and selected Option C (“Wood is light”) instead of the correct Option B (“Wood is buoyant”), misinterpreting the best explanatory principle. Floating is explained by buoyancy (density relative to water per Archimedes’ principle), not merely by being “light.” The agent also bypassed the instructed workflow of engaging a specialist and systematic information gathering, leading to an unverified and incorrect answer.
